The ideal candidate will have a broad and thorough understanding of propulsion/fluid system component fabrication including extrusions, draw forming, welded and seamless tubing, cutting, and assembly, along with associated processes. This candidate should have the desire and capability to take on new challenges in unfamiliar areas to help enable our mission to Mars. jobs.title: Teacher
jobs.department: Boca Chica Ad Astra School Operations
jobs.description_text: TEACHER Ad Astra is a private school and learner-driven community with the mission to encourage each person who enters its doors to find a calling and change the world. Our school consists of four studios: Spark (Grades K-2), Discovery (Grades 3-5), Adventure (Grades 6-8), and Launch Pad (Grades 9-12). This is not a traditional school model. In all areas of school life, our learners are empowered to be in the driver’s seat of their learning. We combine elements of the Montessori method with Socratic guiding, hands-on experiential missions, rigorous curricula, and adaptive technology. We support each student on their personalized journey by fostering an engaging learning environment that feels more like an adventure than school, while still upholding highly rigorous academic standards. Our real-world missions culminate in a public exhibition of learning every 6-8 weeks to allow our students to demonstrate their brilliance in multiple ways. RESPONSIBILITIES: Ensure high levels of each student’s academic achievement and growth Build a positive studio culture of hard work, high standards, warmth, and joy Employ pedagogical best practices aligned to our mission, vision, and values Provide structured academic interventions in response to real-time formative data Write lesson plans and rigorous, engaging projects for students Communicate with parents about student SEL and academic progress Participate as part of a broader team to foster cross-studio programs and initiatives Motivate

jobs.title: Senior Staff Project Engineer
jobs.description_text: We are looking to add a Principal Project Engineer to our team. If you enjoy working in a startup environment and are passionate about developing leading-edge communications satellites, we would like to hear from you. In this position, you will be responsible for project engineering through all phases of the development process for both external customers and internally driven projects. The ideal candidate will have experience in project management, quality assurance, manufacturing of electronic and mechanical assemblies, supply chain, and organization across engineering functions. Experience on aerospace systems development is required, with space flight development preferred. You will utilize your practical engineering expertise to estimate and manage project budgets and timelines for highly technical projects. Specific job functions will include developing project schedules, budgets, and risks and reporting to program and company leadership on a regular basis. You will coordinate activities across teams and raise issues at the program level to ensure proper resourcing. You will help to drive complex programs to success. The successful candidate will present engineering design review materials and status reports to our customers and executive team, as well as participate in proposal-writing efforts. As such, excellent written and verbal communication skills are required.

jobs.title: Senior Staff Thermal Engineer
jobs.description_text: We are looking to add a Senior Staff Thermal Engineer to our team. If you enjoy working in a startup environment and are passionate about developing leading-edge hardware for satellites, spacecraft, and aerospace systems, we would like to hear from you. In this position, you will be responsible for the design, analysis, and validation of thermal control systems for CesiumAstro’s next-generation products. The ideal candidate will combine extensive experience in developing and analyzing thermal management systems for spacecraft, satellite electronics, and airborne systems with deep knowledge in space and aerospace thermal environments. As a senior member of a cross-functional team, you will be responsible for thermal designs from initial concept design through requirements definition, detailed design, simulation/analysis, manufacturing, testing, qualification of CesiumAstro's products. You will work closely with other electrical and mechanical engineers on an integrated team to develop highly optimized solutions. The successful candidate will also present engineering design review materials to customers and upper management, as well as participate in proposal-writing efforts. As such, excellent written and verbal communication skills are required.

This role administers the company's travel policy, including policy setup in Ramp, and ensures travel spending meets company policy and applicable government requirements, such as per diem and lodging rate limits. Working cross-functionally with finance, accounting, operations, and program management, this role advises employees and leaders on travel policy, tracks changes to government travel regulations, and contributes to planning cycles and improvement initiatives.

jobs.title: Senior Wire Harness Design Engineer
jobs.description_text: We are looking to add a Senior Wire Harness Design Engineer to our team. If you enjoy working in a startup environment and are passionate about developing leading-edge hardware for satellites, spacecraft, and aerospace systems, we would like to hear from you. This role focuses on designing the critical power, digital, analog, and RF interconnects that turn boxes into systems. You will have the opportunity to take full ownership of wire harness designs, including schematic development, cable routing, connector selection, and harness assembly drawings. The environment is highly collaborative, working shoulder-to-shoulder with electrical engineers, mechanical engineers, and harness assembly technicians to develop cutting-edge space and airborne systems. The role encompasses the full design process, from defining initial specifications through integration and test. You will also participate in design reviews, providing technical expertise and recommendations to enhance the performance and reliability of wire harness systems.

jobs.title: Staff Applications Engineer
jobs.location_raw: El Segundo, CA · Austin, TX · Westminster, CO
jobs.description_text: We are looking to add several Senior Applications Engineer II to our rapidly growing customer-facing team. In this position, you will represent Cesium as a technical expert on our products, building relationships with our customers from the marketing stage all the way through in-orbit support. A major part of CesiumAstro’s mission is to deliver space communication systems that work out of the box, and the Applications Engineering Team will play a crucial role in delivering that seamless user experience. As a CesiumAstro Applications Engineer, you can expect a varied and dynamic day-to-day workflow. Some days will be spent in the lab with CesiumAstro design engineers, learning the ins and outs of our hardware and software. Some days will be spent helping shape the Cesium product roadmap by providing feedback on customer needs, goals, and user experience; you will act as the “Voice of the Customer” to provide insight and clarity to developers. Some days will be spent at customers’ labs or on video calls, teaching customers how to use our products. Some days will be spent crafting app notes and diagrams to provide users with a space communication system that truly works out of the box. This role is heavily focused on technical customer interaction. As such, exceptional technical communication skills are required. Candidates with relevant work samples, such as public app notes or user manuals, will be highly preferred. This role may require up to 20% travel to customer facilities

jobs.title: Staff Electrical Engineer - RPU Unit Lead
jobs.location_raw: El Segundo, CA · Austin, TX · Westminster, CO
jobs.description_text: We are seeking a highly skilled Staff ElectricalEngineer to lead the design, development, integration, test, and flight qualification of advanced spaceborne payloads. This post focuses on the role of Unit Lead (aka Responsible Engineer) in our Reconfigurable Processing Unit (RPU) product line. CesiumAstro RPUs are complex, VPX-based electronics boxes consisting of our software-defined radios, single-board computers, power supply modules, and RF front ends, driven by CesiumAstro modems and software. The Unit Lead is responsible for bothtechnical definition and execution of a new RPU product. This combines deep, multi-disciplinary technical accountability with responsibility for on-time schedule execution. The project may include the development of new VPX module products, new backplanes and interface options, and/or new software features, coming together into a qualified, customer-ready product. The Unit Lead is the leader of the multidisciplinary technical team, the primary point of contact for the program manager, and often a key interface point for our customers. Success in this role requires strength in technical topics as well as project management, leadership, and communication in a fast-paced startup environment.

jobs.title: Staff EMI/EMC Engineer

The ideal candidate will play a critical role in ensuring that our space systems, including spacecraft, satellites, and ground support equipment, meet all EMI/EMC requirements and standards. You will work closely with cross-functional teams, including design, test, and systems engineering, to develop, analyze, and implement EMI/EMC control strategies that ensure the integrity and performance of our products in the harsh environments of space.

The ideal candidate will be versatile and proficient in mechanical analysis, electronics packaging, computer-aided design (CAD), mechanical interfaces, thermal architecture, spacecraft propulsion, deployable and actuated structures, and environmental qualification of spacecraft antennas and payloads. This role focuses on ensuring product performance, yield optimization, and reliability through direct support of manufacturing operations. jobs.title: Staff Propulsion Engineer

This role requires both deep technical expertise and the ability to guide and mentor engineering teams within a fast-paced start-up environment. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in FEA and thermal simulations, combined with hands-on experience in experimental development and testing of high-performance aerospace systems. This role involves close collaboration with an international R&D team to optimize performance and reliability of LV hardware.

jobs.title: Staff Quality Engineer
jobs.description_text: We are looking to add an experienced and talented Senior Quality Engineer to our team. In this position, you use a variety of process improvement tactics, including lean manufacturing, Six Sigma methodology, and Kaizen. Your job is to collect data and analyze current operating procedures to determine which continuous improvement process technique is the best for our situation. QA Engineer will also be responsible for the inception, maintenance and update of central directives pertaining to systematic problem solving, process quality engineering and Lean manufacturing principles within QMS. This role is multi-dimensional requiring interfacing with internal customers (Management, Engineering (SW & HW), and Manufacturing) to drive the corrective action culture and in due course transitioning into a lean process quality engineer optimizing the production system using lessons learned (LL) methodology and Lean/ Six sigma principles.

jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer – Test Automation & Infrastructure
jobs.description_text: We are seeking a Staff Software Engineer – Test Automation & Infrastructure to develop and scale automated test systems supporting the validation of complex RF and satellite communications payloads. This role sits at the intersection of software development and hardware test engineering, building robust automation frameworks and infrastructure that ensure reliable, repeatable system validation. You will play a key role in improving product quality, accelerating development cycles, and enabling seamless integration across hardware and software systems.

jobs.title: Summer 2027 - Electrical Engineering Internship, Hardware
jobs.description_text: The CesiumAstro Hardware Design Team is looking for Summer 2027 interns to design and build electronics hardware for satellite communication systems. On the CesiumAstro Hardware Design Team, we are responsible for full-stack hardware development for cutting-edge space electronics. We own designs from initial concept through part selection, schematic, layout, build, test, and delivery, all the way through in-orbit support. Designs encompass the spectrum of electronics design, including high-speed digital, power electronics, and RF hardware – often on the same board. We’re looking for summer interns to support our mission. Interns work side-by-side with design engineers: contributing to the company’s success is as high of a priority as learning and gaining experience. Interns are typically responsible for their own schematics and layouts as well as supporting analysis and hands-on lab work. Specific assignments will be determined by a mix of project availability and candidate interests. If you are an electrical engineering student who wants to sink your teeth into the rigor of space electronics design, this is the job for you. To apply, please include a brief cover letter describing your interest in electronics hardware design and in this particular role.

Areas of focus will include either board-level RF electronics design (e.g. front-ends with amplifiers, switches, filters, etc.) system design, or antenna design. Assignments will be determined by a mix of project availability and the interests of the successful candidates. CesiumAstro interns regularly present their work to peers, mentors, and CesiumAstro executive leadership throughout the course of the summer. As such, excellent written and verbal communication skills are required. To apply, please include a cover letter describing your interest in RF hardware or antennas and either space systems or communication systems.

Interns in the Analog & Power team are typically responsible for design projects that directly contribute towards an on-going program or contribute towards advancing the Analog & Power Electronics team’s technology development road map. You will have the opportunity to use and maintain state-of-the-art electronics lab instrumentation, such as spectrum analyzers, VNAs, automated power supplies, and more. As such, the ability to understand and work from drawings, diagrams, schematics, and test procedures is key. jobs.title: Account Manager Enterprise Partnerships, California/Washington
jobs.description_text: Healthcare is changing, and local medical practices are caught in the middle. They are trying to shift from a system that rewards the volume of procedures to one that rewards the quality of patient care—but navigating that shift is incredibly tough. That’s where you come in. As our Account Manager, you will be the ultimate strategic partner, business coach, and advocate for the medical practices in your portfolio. You are the day-to-day anchor of these relationships, responsible for diving into the data, identifying performance gaps, and working hand-in-hand with doctors and healthcare executives. By helping them master Value-Based Care (VBC) contracts, you directly drive financial success (shared savings) and, most importantly, measurably better health outcomes for the community. Note on Travel: On-site check-ins are key to this role. You can expect to travel in-person approximately 1x per month per account for 2–3 days (supporting accounts in Northern California and the Seattle, Washington area). Exact schedules flex based on client needs, meaning some months may feel lighter or heavier than others. Location Requirement: This is a remote role, but candidates must be based on the West Coast (preferably within driving distance or short regional flight access to Northern California or the Seattle, WA area) to accommodate monthly client visits.

jobs.title: Care Manager, Michigan
jobs.description_text: The Care Manager will work with primary care practices as a part of the Provider Delivered Care Management Program (PDCMP). The Care Manager collaborates with the care team within each practice and leverages Aledade’s interdisciplinary care team to provide telephone-based health coaching, quality improvement, and care coordination. The Care Manager works closely with patients to support them in becoming active in their health care by better understanding their chronic conditions, helping them access care in the most appropriate setting, and improving quality of care. Care Managers utilize Aledade’s proprietary population health tool, the “Aledade App” to manage high-risk patients, using real-time data to identify and intervene on high utilizers who could benefit from more preventative and active management. Location Requirement: This is a remote role within Michigan. Candidates must be based in the state of Michigan to be considered. Salary Range: $70,000 to $87,000 base + bonus + equity Compensation for the role will depend on a number of factors, including a candidate’s qualifications, skills, competencies and experience.

jobs.title: Clinical Outreach Specialist
jobs.description_text: As a Clinical Outreach Specialist, you will serve as a vital clinical bridge for high-risk patients, utilizing your clinical expertise to navigate the critical window between hospital discharge and home recovery. In this high-impact, telephonic role, you will perform complex medication reconciliations, identify looming clinical red flags, and proactively close care gaps to prevent unnecessary ER visits and readmissions. By blending empathetic patient education with data-driven population health tools, you will empower patients to manage their health effectively while collaborating directly with primary care practices to ensure no one falls through the cracks of the healthcare system. We are flexible with respect to geographic location, and the ideal candidate will be comfortable working remotely/work from home across US time zones.

jobs.title: Encounter Data Submissions Program Manager (remote)
jobs.description_text: The Encounter Data Submissions Program Manager will assist in the development of an end to end Encounter Data Submission and Reconciliation program, to include creation of program guide and standard operating procedures. The program manager will collaborate across teams to better understand and evaluate ROI of existing Alternate Submission Method (ASM) workstreams, as well as potential ROI improvements as a result of workflow efficiencies and enhancements. Additionally, once established, the program manager will oversee daily EDS and reconciliation processes. This Manager will lead the design and implementation of Aledade’s end-to-end Encounter Data Submission and Reconciliation program, including the creation of comprehensive program guides and Standard Operating Procedures. You will act as a cross-functional leader, evaluating the ROI of existing Alternate Submission Method (ASM) workstreams and driving workflow enhancements that directly improve data accuracy and operational efficiency. Once established, you will provide oversight of the daily EDS and reconciliation processes, ensuring that clinical encounter data—the lifeblood of value-based care—is accurately captured, validated, and submitted to payers and CMS with total integrity. We are flexible with respect to geographic location, and the ideal candidate will be comfortable working remotely/work from home within the US.

jobs.title: Executive Assistant, Remote
jobs.description_text: The Executive Assistant (EA) serves as a strategic executive business partner supporting 3-4 assigned senior leadership members (SVPs+). Moving beyond traditional administrative support, the EA leverages organizational insight to optimize executive efficacy, proactively mitigate operational risks, and streamline cross-functional workflows. Operating in a fast-paced environment, this role acts as a trusted gatekeeper and operational liaison, ensuring leadership focus remains strictly aligned with company priorities.

jobs.title: Executive Director, Enterprise Partnerships, Minnesota
jobs.description_text: Executive Directors, Enterprise Partnerships are the business leads for large, strategic hospital and health system accounts. They act as a link between the field and Aledade Centralized support teams, focusing on ACO-specific business operations. Executive Directors partner with Medical Directors to align clinical initiatives with savings goals and provide the business case and direction for field team practice interactions. The Executive Director, Enterprise Partnerships, will be pivotal in building Aledade’s service model in the Minnesota market and beyond for a core group of strategic partners.

jobs.title: Payer Operations Analyst
jobs.description_text: The Payer Data Operations Analyst ensures data quality, accuracy, and reliability across payer data pipelines to support value-based contract performance. This role applies technical data skills and cross-functional leadership to resolve complex data issues, build proactive monitoring solutions, and partner with internal teams and payers to continuously enhance end-to-end data integrity.

jobs.title: Pharmacy Outreach Specialist (Remote)
jobs.description_text: As a Pharmacy Outreach Specialist, you'll be a vital link between patients, providers, and pharmacies, helping people stay on track with the medications that keep them healthy. In this role, you'll combine empathy, problem-solving, and clear communication to break down the real-world barriers that keep patients from taking their medications as prescribed, from cost concerns to simple forgetfulness. Your work directly improves patient health outcomes and contributes to pharmacy quality measures that matter across the healthcare system, all while building valuable skills in patient engagement, pharmacy operations, and healthcare communication.

jobs.title: Program Manager, Implementation (Launch)
jobs.description_text: The Program Manager (Launch)is responsible for leading the program workstreams that guide partner practices through Aledade's onboarding journey to achieve sustained success in value-based care. Operating with a high degree of autonomy, this role structures, executes, and monitors assigned launch initiatives, establishing clear milestones and task structures aligned with overall program objectives to maintain project timelines. By leveraging data-driven governance and program discipline, the Program Manager ensures full transparency into launch progress and identifies potential roadblocks early. Core responsibilities include designing workstream operational frameworks, defining and monitoring key performance indicators (KPIs), proactively mitigating risks, and driving strategic alignment across Sales, Field, Implementation, and Product teams. The Program Manager facilitates cross-functional execution and directly oversees key launch deliverables to meet organizational goals. Combining strong organizational leadership with deep healthcare technology expertise, the ideal candidate thrives in dynamic environments to advance Aledade's mission in value-based care.

jobs.title: Program Specialist, CMMI Programs
jobs.description_text: Reporting directly to the Center for Medicare and Medicaid Innovation (CMMI) Program Manager, the Program Specialist will be a pivotal contributor to the operational excellence and strategic growth of our CMMI initiatives. jobs.title: E-Space 2027 Summer Internship, Arlington TX
jobs.description_text: As a company, E-Space does not believe in sticking to the path that has already been trodden. We are encountering new problems every day that need new ways of thinking. At E-Space, we use a first principles approach to solving tough technical challenges, and we look at problems differently. Most aerospace internships hand you one project, one team, and a report-out slide at the end of summer. E-Space is different: we’re a vertically integrated space company building spacecraft manufacturing capability from the ground up in Arlington, TX, and we’re writing the playbook, rather than following someone else’s. That means our interns aren’t boxed into a single lane. Our previous interns have worked across multiple disciplines in a single cohort, pitched and built their own passion projects, and watched ideas they proposed become hardware that flies, not something that gets shelved after a final presentation. If you want the mission and scale of a rapidly scaling aerospace and defense company without layers of process that come with it, this is where you should build it yourself!

jobs.description_text: E-Space is building the infrastructure for a new generation of space operations. As we scale to the next stage of growth over the next 18 months, we need someone to programmatize how we communicate internally and deliberately build culture that sustains retention and belonging. This is a builder role: you'll take what exists and create the infrastructure, cadences, and editorial strategy that make E-Space feel like a coherent company where people understand the mission, where their work connects to it, and where they genuinely want to show up. You'll balance two equally important missions: (1) owning the systems and channels that keep E-Space informed and aligned as we scale, and (2) collaborating with the People team to build intentional culture programs, celebrations, and spaces that make work feel meaningful and connected. You'll do this in an environment where the exec leadership, People team, and cross-functional partners all have competingasks, a level of ambiguity, and high expectations, and where the guardrails aren't yet clear. You'll need to be comfortable making calls about what gets done, in what order, and what doesn't, without waiting for permission. It’s important to note that this role is internally facing because the company is currently in Stealth Mode as we build our world-class technology, so this role will not include any aspect of external comms or PR. jobs.description_text: GenBio AI is an AI for Science company on a mission to make biology fully computable. We are building AIDO (AI-Driven Digital Organism) to simulate living systems, decode biology holistically, and accelerate medical and scientific research. Our first step toward that mission is AIDO Cell, the first virtual cell world model that holistically simulates cell biology from molecules up to whole-cell behavior. It enables researchers to run experiments virtually, predicting how cells respond to genetic changes, drugs and other interventions before going into the lab. It is supported by AIDO Foundry, an AI-builds-AI engineering framework for automating virtual cell development, and AIDO Lab, an interface to digitally run experiments and observe the results. Together they form the foundation for a new paradigm in AI-driven drug discovery, bioengineering, and fundamental biomedical research.

jobs.description_text: Own the State. Lead the Team. Drive the Growth. Are you a strategic sales leader with deep expertise in automotive finance and a passion for building high-performing teams? Lendbuzz is looking for a Sales Director to lead our field sales efforts across the State, managing a team of Market Development Managers (MDMs) and overseeing statewide dealer growth, performance, and profitability. As a Sales Director you’ll be responsible for translating our national sales vision into localized strategy and execution. You’ll coach and develop your field team, guide territory expansion, and build strong dealer relationships to ensure consistent growth in contract volume and market share. jobs.description_text: Empower Sales Success Through Training and Development At Lendbuzz, we believe in doing the right thing—for our customers, our team, and our future. As we continue to expand our footprint, we’re looking for an organized, high-energy Sales Training & Development Coordinator to keep our training operations running smoothly and support our field sales team. This role is perfect for someone who thrives in a fast-paced, high-growth environment, possesses exceptional organizational skills, and loves supporting the growth of sales professionals. If you are a detail-oriented coordinator who enjoys managing logistics, keeping pristine data records, and helping build structured onboarding experiences, this is your opportunity to make a massive impact. jobs.title: Talent Acquisition Specialist (Sales)
jobs.description_text: We're looking for a talented and driven Talent Acquisition Specialist to join our Corporate TA team and own full-cycle recruiting for Lendbuzz's growing sales organization. You'll work closely with the Talent Acquisition Manager and partner directly with regional sales hiring managers across the country. This is a role for someone who takes real ownership. You won't just be filling reqs - you'll be a true partner to the hiring team, helping shape how we attract, engage, and hire top sales talent at scale. If you're proactive, people-driven, and energized by fast-moving environments, we'd love to meet you. This role will be based out of our Boston headquarters with a hybrid schedule, requiring 2 to 3 days in the office per week.

jobs.title: Manufacturing Engineer – Automotive
jobs.description_text: About Machina Labs: Engineering moves at software speed. Manufacturing doesn't. Yet. Machina Labs is changing that. We build intelligent, software-defined factories that produce complex metal structures directly from digital design. By integrating advanced metal forming, robotics, and automated production inside a flexible factory architecture, we enable customers to move from prototype to production in weeks, not years. Backed by Lockheed Martin, Toyota, and NVIDIA, we're building the manufacturing infrastructure that defense, aerospace, and advanced mobility programs will run on. If you want to work on hard problems that matter and see them fly, drive, and defend, this is the place. Actual compensation will be determined based on experience, skills, qualifications, and geographic location. In addition to the provided base salary range, comprehensive benefits (Medical, Dental, Vision), PTO, and Stock Options.
